name: Directing, Not Typing
description: The shift from writing every line yourself to directing an AI tool effectively — prompting for code, evaluating output critically, and knowing when to take over manually.

name: Reading Code You Didn't Write
description: Read an unfamiliar diff for intent, control flow, data shape and dependency cost fast enough to review it properly.

name: Correctness, Security and Failure Modes
description: Catch the specific defects AI tools produce most, before they reach a branch anyone else depends on.

name: Agentic Workflows
description: Run multi-step AI work — decomposition, tool access, verification of a chain rather than a completion — without losing control of the blast radius.

name: Shipping and Operating
description: Get AI-assisted changes through tests, review, CI and deploy — and be able to operate what you shipped.

name: Working as an AI-Assisted Developer
description: Scope, price, disclose and defend AI-assisted work — and prove it on one change you take from request to shipped.
